{{Quote|I am Chieftain Velasu Graege, uniter of the Kaleesh tribes and bane of the old Empire!|Velasu Graege|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Velasu Graege''' was a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] who was the leader of the Kaleesh mercenaries who joined [[Darth Malgus]]' [[New Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was later killed during the [[Battle of Ilum]].
